payload.text: Intent's dry run and cut, corrected forward on 2026-11-27 from the 3.5.6 cut's log: the dry run runs release.preflight only (six commands, none of them macOS), so it reads no keychain item and signs nothing. The cut's macOS leg (bin/.devbin/cmd/macos, Intent's own handler) is the first step that reads the three generic-password items from the login keychain file and signs and submits with --apple-id, --password and --team-id. At 3.5.6 that leg went green at 05:29:39Z. No notarytool profile and no data-protection item is in that path. Limits: a system sleep stops any run, and a login keychain set to lock on sleep or idle locks the file (security show-keychain-info reads the setting), so tell hv that a keychain prompt can come in the macOS leg. Keep the display awake only on hv's word. Ask devbin-vc before any kovacs leg. The cut stays hv's keystroke (hv decision 3).
